title: TopCoW images, masks and derived centerline graphs
version_note: TopCoW training release 15692630 and graph release 17358162, as curated on 2026-09-16 in BR-025; exact selected files, CRC checks and hashes remain in the curation receipt.
terms_note: Historical terms recorded in BR-025 on 2026-09-16: TopCoW requires attribution and owner permission for commercial use; derived graphs are CC BY-NC. These observations are not a current redistribution clearance.
reference_note: TopCoW masks cover named Circle of Willis components within the source annotation scope. Centerline graphs derive from those masks, so they are not a second independent anatomical truth. The retained 244-voxel BR-026 addition dispute is clinically unresolved.
access_note: Selected source images, masks and graph members were retained locally. This source index does not acquire data or establish current access; recheck exact terms and availability when selecting a release for reuse.
